all.label: All
all.rule: Any significant news or feature story about the country.

feel_good.label: Feel good
feel_good.rule: An uplifting, hopeful or heart-warming story: kindness, recovery, achievement, discovery, conservation success, culture or community. Exclude stories whose main subject is death, war, disaster, crime, abuse or political conflict.

science.label: Science
science.rule: A story whose main subject is science: research findings, space, nature and wildlife science, medicine and health research, climate or earth science.

technology.label: Technology
technology.rule: A story whose main subject is technology: computing, the internet, AI, gadgets, telecoms, engineering, tech companies or digital policy.
